wargear.name: Icon of the Sixteenth
wargear.text: Each Model in a Unit that includes a Model equipped with an Icon of the Sixteenth adds 1 to its Willpower Characteristic and 1 to its Intelligence Characteristic.
wargear.summary: A scarred eye-icon carried by the Legion's proudest companies, a reminder of who they serve.

wargear.name: Mournival oath-seals
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Mournival oath-seals has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule.
wargear.summary: Wax and iron seals pressed over the heart of a bodyguard who has sworn to fall before the Warmaster does.

wargear.name: Laurel of the Victors
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Laurel of the Victors has the Victor's Laurel Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A circlet of beaten gold awarded after a bloody triumph.

wargear.name: Pennant of Cthonia
wargear.text: Each Model in a Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Pennant of Cthonia has the Cthonian Spirit Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A tattered pennant carried from the Legion's first home.

wargear.name: Chieftain's war-horn
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Chieftain's war-horn has the War-horn Call Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A long ivory horn that carries across a battlefield.

wargear.name: Spiked ram-plate
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Spiked ram-plate has the Spiked Prow Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A hooked prow-blade for tearing through barricades and infantry.

wargear.name: Death-oath sigil
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Death-oath sigil has the Oath of Vengeance Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A rune sworn to avenge any brother who falls beside the bearer.

wargear.name: Claim-spike standard
wargear.text: Each Model in a Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Claim-spike standard has the Planted Standard Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A barbed pole driven into captured ground.

rites.name: The Mournival's Word
rites.flavor: Four captains speak, and the Legion moves as one voice.
benefits: Chieftain, Praetorian Command and Centurion Command Squads may fill Troops slots.

Every Command and High Command model gains +1 Willpower and Voice of the Mournival: friendly Sons of Horus units within 12" add 1 to their Leadership and Cool when making Leadership Checks and Cool Checks.
limitations: At least two High Command units are required.
No Tactical, Despoiler, Assault, Breacher or Inductii Squads.

modifiers.text: The Mournival's Word: +1 WP, Voice of the Mournival.

require.note: The Mournival needs at least two High Command units.

rites.name: The Spear of Cthonia
rites.flavor: Where the Warmaster walks, the Justaerin walk one pace ahead.
benefits: Justaerin Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots.
Justaerin gain Deep Strike and Spear Point: on the turn they arrive by Deep Strike they may be declared as Charging, and add +1 to their Hit Tests in that Combat.
limitations: Horus Lupercal, Horus Ascended or Ezekyle Abaddon must lead the army, and at least one Justaerin Squad is required.
Every Justaerin Squad must start the battle in Reserve.
No Fast Attack or Recon units, and nothing with the Antigrav type.

modifiers.text: The Spear of Cthonia: Deep Strike, Spear Point.

require.note: Horus or Abaddon must lead the Spear.
Bring at least one Justaerin Squad.

rites.name: Reaver Doctrine
rites.flavor: Strike the vox-tower, kill the legate, be gone before the sirens finish.
benefits: Reaver Attack and Reaver Aggressor Squads may fill Troops slots.
Reaver squads gain Outflank and Reaver Raid: on the turn they enter play from Reserves they add +2 to their Charge Roll.
limitations: Every Reaver squad must start the battle in Reserve, and at least one is required.
No Armour or Lord of War units.

require.note: Bring at least one Reaver squad.

rites.name: The Warmaster's Favour
rites.flavor: Every recruit in the Legion believes his name was spoken at Horus's elbow.
benefits: Inductii Squads gain Sworn to Horus: they add 1 to their Leadership and Cool when making Leadership Checks and Cool Checks while Horus Lupercal or Horus Ascended is on the table.
limitations: Horus Lupercal or Horus Ascended must lead, and at least two Inductii Squads are required.
No more than three High Command units, and no Malefic units.

modifiers.text: The Warmaster's Favour: Sworn to Horus.

limit.note: No more than three High Command units.

rules.name: Voice of the Mournival
rules.text: While a friendly Sons of Horus Unit is within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule, each Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Leadership Characteristic and 1 to its Cool Characteristic when making Leadership Checks and Cool Checks.
rules.summary: Four captains speak, and the Legion moves as one voice.

rules.name: Spear Point
rules.text: A Unit made up entirely of Models with this Special Rule that arrives by Deep Strike may have a Charge declared for it in the Charge Sub-Phase of the same Player Turn, and adds 1 to its Hit Tests in the Combat that follows.
rules.summary: The Justaerin land at the Warmaster's side and do not slow down.

rules.name: Reaver Raid
rules.text: A Unit made up entirely of Models with this Special Rule that enters play from Reserves adds 2 to its Charge Roll in the Player Turn in which it enters play.
rules.summary: The strike lands before the sirens finish.

rules.name: Sworn to Horus
rules.text: While Horus Lupercal or Horus Ascended is on the Battlefield, each Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Leadership Characteristic and 1 to its Cool Characteristic when making Leadership Checks and Cool Checks.
rules.summary: The recruit believes his name was spoken at the Warmaster's elbow.

rules.name: Victor's Laurel
rules.text: A Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Charge Rolls.
rules.summary: Gold awarded after bloody triumph draws the whole company forward.

rules.name: Cthonian Spirit
rules.text: When a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule makes a Charge Roll, any result of less than 5 is treated as a 5.
rules.summary: Cthonian pride does not allow a short charge.

rules.name: War-horn Call
rules.text: Once per Battle, at the start of its Movement Phase, a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule may ignore the effects of the Pinned Status or the Suppressed Status until the end of that Phase.
rules.summary: The horn carries across the field and rouses the broken.

rules.name: Spiked Prow
rules.text: When a Vehicle with this Special Rule moves through an enemy Unit, increase the number of Hits it inflicts by 1.
rules.summary: A hooked prow-blade tears through barricades and infantry alike.

rules.name: Oath of Vengeance
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic in any Combat in which a friendly Model from its Unit was removed as a Casualty earlier in the same Battle Turn.
rules.summary: A brother has fallen at the bearer's side, and the bearer will answer for it.

rules.name: Planted Standard
rules.text: When a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule is counted for Controlling an Objective, it counts as having two additional Models for the purposes of determining Tactical Strength.
rules.summary: A barbed pole driven into captured ground marks it as the Legion's own.

armyRules.name: Lupercal's Vanguard
armyRules.flavor: The Sixteenth strike first and strike hard.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Charge Rolls in the Battle Turn in which its Unit enters play from Reserves and during the first Battle Turn.
drawbacks: From the third Battle Turn, until its Unit has fought in a Combat, every Model in the Unit subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic.
armyRules.condition: from the third battle turn, until the unit has fought in a Combat

armyRules.name: Mournival Pride
armyRules.flavor: Proud captains fight under the Warmaster's eye.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Focus Roll when Engaged in a Challenge.
drawbacks: A Model with this Special Rule may never decline a Challenge.
If a Model with this Special Rule is removed as a Casualty, every friendly Sons of Horus Unit within 12" must make a Cool Check or gain the Suppressed Status.

armyRules.name: Hubris of the Sixteenth
armyRules.flavor: The Legion has never lost a war and acts like it.
benefits: A Unit with this Special Rule ignores the effects of the Pinned Status.
drawbacks: Every Model with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from its Intelligence Characteristic.
